learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to count sweet and yummy mangoes from 1 to 9!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look at the big green tree! Let us point our finger and count the yellow mangoes one by one. One, two, three, four!
Some yummy mangoes are kept in a basket. Can you guess how many? Let us count them aloud together to find the magic number.
We have magic counters right on our hands! We can open our fingers one by one to count all the sweet mangoes from 1 to 9.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Yellow Mango Fingerprints
fun_activity.instructions: Dip your thumb in yellow paint and make 9 little mangoes on a piece of paper. Count them aloud as you make each one!

quick_recap: ⭐ We learned how to count things from 1 to 9 by pointing at them.
⭐ We used our fingers to count sweet mangoes and had lots of fun!
